name: blood_ritual_life_scale
notes: Blood Ritual: how much of the Life pool pays for a share of the Mana pool, as a multiple of the same fraction. name: poison_dart_shot_delay_seconds

name: poison_dart_tick_seconds

name: corpse_spiders_impact_pct

name: corpse_spiders_lifetime_seconds

name: corpse_spiders_hits_per_spider

name: corpse_spiders_reach_yards

name: plague_of_toads_rain_speed_bonus
